full_name: David Hemenway | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Social Sciences Elizabeth S. and Richard M. Cashin Fellow Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
bio: David Hemenway is a professor of health policy at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health and director of the Harvard Injury Control Research Center and Harvard Youth Violence Prevention Center. He teaches classes on injury and on economics and has written widely in the fields of economics and public health.
